title: Battle Top-Right OAM Rider HUD
description: Selected-card element rider icons (OAM sprites, not BG tiles). Cells are enemy_sprites sheet names (compose_enemy_sprites.py TILE_COORDS); values are slotted OBJ ramps (palette.txt) used both to encode the tile bytes and to program the battle OBJ slot the icon renders with (rider_tiles_generated.h).
